sn22.53:1.3: Rūpupāyam bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya rūpārammaṇaṃ rūpapatiṭṭhaṃ nandupasevanaṃ virūḷhiṃ vuddhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyya || ||
sn22.53:1.6: Saṅkhārā rammaṇaṃ saṅkhārapatiṭṭhaṃ nandupasevanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullam āpajjeyya || || 5
sn22.53:2.2: Aham aññatra rūpā aññatra vedanāya aññatra saññāya aññatra saṅkhārehi viññāṇassa āgatiṃ vā gatiṃ vā cutiṃ vā upapattiṃ vā vuddhiṃ vā virūḷhiṃ vā vepullaṃ vā paññāpessamīti netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati || || 6-10
sn22.53:3.1: Rūpadhātuyā ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti ||
sn22.53:3.2: rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇam patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || ||
sn22.53:3.6: Viññāṇadhātuyā ce bhikkhave bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti ||
sn22.53:3.7: rāgassa pahānā vocchijjatārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti || || 11
sn22.53:3.8: Tad apatiṭṭhitam viññāṇam avirūḷhaṃ anabhisaṅkhārañca vimuttam ||
sn22.53:3.9: vimuttattā ṭhitam ṭhitattā santusitaṃ santusitattā na paritassati || aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati || ||
sn22.53:3.10: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyam kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || 1-2
